messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: DIR, Art. 5(1)

Article 5 Placing on the market and putting into service. 1. Before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service, the manufacturer or his authorised representative shall: (a) ensure that it satisfies the relevant essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex I; (b) ensure that the technical file referred to in Annex VII, part A is available; (c) provide, in particular, the necessary information, such as instructions; (d) carry out the appropriate procedures for assessing conformity in accordance with Article 12; (e) draw up the EC declaration of conformity in accordance with Annex II, part 1, Section A and ensure that it accompanies the machinery; (f) affix the CE marking in accordance with Article 16.

manufacturer or authorised representative | ensureSatisfiesEssentialRequirements | machinery satisfies the relevant essential health and safety requirements in Annex I | before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service | "ensure that it satisfies the relevant essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex I"
manufacturer or authorised representative | ensureAvailable | technical file referred to in Annex VII, part A | before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service | "ensure that the technical file referred to in Annex VII, part A is available"
manufacturer or authorised representative | provideInformation | necessary information, such as instructions | before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service | "provide, in particular, the necessary information, such as instructions"
manufacturer or authorised representative | carryOutConformityAssessment | appropriate conformity assessment procedures under Article 12 | before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service | "carry out the appropriate procedures for assessing conformity in accordance with Article 12"
manufacturer or authorised representative | drawUpDeclarationOfConformity | EC declaration of conformity in accordance with Annex II, part 1, Section A | before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service | "draw up the EC declaration of conformity in accordance with Annex II, part 1, Section A"
manufacturer or authorised representative | ensureDeclarationAccompanies | EC declaration of conformity accompanies the machinery | before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service | "ensure that it accompanies the machinery"
manufacturer or authorised representative | affixCEMarking | CE marking on the machinery | before placing machinery on the market and/or putting it into service | "affix the CE marking in accordance with Article 16"
